alt: Anterior thigh muscles labeled - iliopsoas (psoas major + iliacus), tensor fasciae latae, rectus femoris, vastus lateralis, vastus medialis, sartorius, adductor group (gracilis, adductor longus/magnus/brevis, pectineus).
caption: Anterior thigh muscles (Gray's Anatomy) - quadriceps (rectus femoris + 3 vasti), adductor group (gracilis, adductor longus/magnus/brevis, pectineus), sartorius, iliopsoas. Extends knee; flexes/adducts hip.
